records.supported_name_scope: The complete generalized source polygon is associated with Dauphin Lake. The narrow northern basin, west-side indentation, widening southeastern body and rounded southern shore correspond to the provincial plan maps. This is a generalized waterbody identity, not a surveyed shoreline or scalar-name approval.
correspondence_observations: Both provincial map panels show the same entire north-south lake east of Dauphin and southwest of Lake Winnipegosis. The candidate has that position and complete characteristic outline.
The source has no extension north along Mossy River into separately mapped Lake Winnipegosis; the provincial narrative describes a single river outlet between the lakes.
The plan distinguishes lakeshore marshes from the lake. These are scope/shoreline qualifications, not evidence of a compound of independently named lakes.
name_scope_limits: The source is a generalized Natural Earth 1:10 million polygon; mapped marsh margins and detailed shoreline differences are unresolved.
The plan is a historical planning document; PDF creation and modification dates are file metadata, not verified publication or present shoreline dates.
ECCC station coordinates and names confirm regional usage at two sites, not whole-lake boundaries.
No formal naming instrument, current registry status, exact shoreline fit, Korean name or legally defined name extent was established.

publication_scope: Own factual observations, short source labels, original URLs, response-body hashes and inspection locators; no original publication bodies, extracted full texts or map images.
